payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions, including mispronunciations and other disfluencies.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions that include mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and other disfluencies.
Annotations for non-standardized orthographic transcriptions are useful for studying historical language changes and building spelling normalization systems.
The resource includes data that allows for the training of models to recognize non-standard pronunciations in speech recognition tasks.
